normalization_plan.reason: Unused self parameter belongs entirely to the execute setup function
agent is the input of grantPermission and has no independent semantic role
requiredPermission is consumed directly by grantPermission
scriptAddress only selects the Script storage entry signed by sign
scriptAddress is the delegatecall target of the execute operation
amount is only used to credit balance and totalSupply inside issueTo
newRate is only stored by setRate
transferAmount is the value moved by the internal transfer
buyTokenId merely indexes the buy order processed by _fillOrder
sellTokenId merely indexes the sell order processed by _fillOrder
lockId only selects the lock released by releaseFunds
loanIds is the batch input of the collect loop
amountToLock is only used for the LTD and KPI update within requestInterest
the Script storage pointer is local to sign and has no independent meaning
tradedWei is a purely local computation feeding the external transfers of _fillOrder
fee is the direct return value of the external calculateTransferFee call
